description: This data set preserves the SCADA record of La Haute Borne, an onshore wind farm in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, France, whose raw data ENGIE once published openly. It was uploaded to Mendeley Data in 2026 by Debela TeKlemariyem, Nasir Hussain Razvi Syed, Abu Al Hassan, Krzysztof Kijanowski, Tomasz Barszcz, Wieslaw Staszewski and Phong Dao because the original ENGIE download is no longer accessible online. The farm has four Senvion MM82 turbines of about 2 MW, with 80 m hub height and cut-in and cut-out speeds of 4 and 22 m/s. It gives 34 process parameters at 10-minute intervals per turbine, each as mean, standard deviation, maximum and minimum, including wind speed and direction, outdoor temperature, bearing and gearbox temperatures, generator speed, power, torque, grid voltage and frequency, and pitch angle, with over one million samples. The abstract documents a gearbox bearing failure on one turbine in January 2015. Coverage is one site, with the abstract citing 2013 to 2020 and the upload covering 2013 to 2018 after cleaning. Files are downloadable from Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: data were cleaned and preprocessed by the uploaders, and period statements differ. Simulation uses are testing condition monitoring and fault detection methods. Related records: data-edp-wind-farm-scada-portugal comes from the same group.
